- Can Redwood confirm milestone owners (both change-management & technical) and realistic target dates?

- Please call out mandatory security artifacts (SOC2 evidence, data retention config) and who will own collection.

Attached: ConcordPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — this is editable.

Next step for us is a mutual timeline we can put into our implementation tracker and share with our VP of Ops. Can you return an updated MAP with owners by EOD Tuesday (Dec 14)?

Alison — thanks for the draft and clear asks. I've taken an initial pass and mapped internal owners to the milestones you listed. Key notes below and attached is a marked-up MAP and a working SOW draft.

Proposed owner assignments (high level):
- Project sponsor / timeline approvals: Alison Reed (ConcordPay) + Camila (Account Lead)
- Implementation lead / delivery owner: Marissa Cole (Sr. CS Manager, Redwood)
- SE & infra tasks: Ben Carter (Solutions Eng)
- Security & compliance evidence: Soojin Lee (Security Program)
- Procurement / commercial redlines: Camila + Redwood Legal (looped as needed)

Target dates I propose (to align to your Jan 24–28 go-live window):
- Procurement complete: 2026-12-21
- Kickoff & environment handoff: 2027-01-04
- Integration & test: 2027-01-05 through 2027-01-18
- Final validation & go/no-go: 2027-01-19 through 2027-01-21
- Go-live window: 2027-01-24 — 2027-01-28

Security artifacts: Soojin will enumerate the SOC2 packet and a short evidence checklist in a separate note.

Attachments: SOW_ConcordPay_v0.9.pdf (draft) and the updated MAP with owner column filled. If those dates look good to you, I can send a calendar invite for the Jan 4 kickoff and confirm the procurement queue items.

Regards,

Alison / Camila — appreciate the draft. I expanded the MAP to include weekly checkpoints and owner-level acceptance criteria for each milestone. Quick highlights:

1) Kickoff (Jan 4) — deliverables: credentials for test env, list of integration endpoints, initial success tests. Owner: Marissa Cole.
2) Integration sprint (Jan 5–Jan 18) — deliverables: API integration, model selection/quantization settings, initial latency baseline. Owner: Ben Carter (SE).
3) Policy & compliance (parallel) — deliverables: SOC2 evidence packet, KMS key exchange plan. Owner: Soojin Lee.
4) UAT & go/no-go (Jan 19–21) — deliverables: runbook, rollback plan, performance acceptance. Owner: Marissa + Ben.

Ben — can you confirm SE bandwidth the week of Jan 4–18? Also list any pre-kickoff tasks (e.g., connection tests, sample payloads) you need before Jan 4.

Alison — if procurement timing slips, we should have a contingency to push kickoff one week; flagged in the MAP.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Marissa — SE bandwidth confirmed. My notes and pre-kickoff checklist below:

Pre-kickoff (to finish by Dec 28):
- Provide test API endpoints and a sample payload (ConcordPay) — owner: Alison / Jian
- Confirm expected peak QPS and sequence lengths — owner: ConcordPay Eng
- Provide IP allowlist (for dedicated trial) or VPN details — owner: ConcordPay infra
- Exchange KMS public key stub for encryption tests — owner: Soojin (security) + ConcordPay Sec

During integration (Jan 5–18):
- Run connection smoke tests (day 1)
- Configure model variant and quantization profile for pilot
- Baseline latency & cost per token (day 5–7)

Risks: if procurement approval is delayed >1 week we may have to compress integration; recommend Jan 31 fallback.

I'll add these items into the MAP and share a short tech-runbook prior to kickoff.

—Ben
